profile.description: Powerful open-source large language model built for agentic coding or autonomous task execution and optimized for refactoring large codebases, debugging runtime error logs, and multi-file project execution. Supported files are PDF, CSS, CSV, JSON, JPG, PNG, WEBP, JS, PY, HTML, XLSX and DOCX. This bot can't process HEIC, AVIF, MP4, MP3, WAV, OBJ, XLS and STL formats.
